Robinhood secures UK crypto registration under FCA’s AML regime ahead of 2027 overhaul

summary: The UK is replacing its narrow crypto registration system with full regulation. Its prospects now turn on authorisation, stablecoin policy, retail access, enforcement, and whether regulated products can compete with overseas markets.
